input.description: Diff input vs output ignoring trailing whitespace
Show line diff between input and output

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import re
a=open('input.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
b=open('output.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
strip=lambda s: re.sub(r'\s+','',s)
print('non-whitespace identical:', strip(a)==strip(b))
print('input chars:',len(strip(a)),'output chars:',len(strip(b)))
print('input lines:',len(a.splitlines()),'output lines:',len(b.splitlines()))
print('ends with single newline:', b.endswith('\n') and not b.endswith('\n\n'))
"
input.description: Compare non-whitespace content of input and output

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import subprocess
def run(*a):
    r = subprocess.run(['python3','.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py',*a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout, end='')
    if r.stderr.strip(): print('STDERR:', r.stderr, end='')
    print('>>> exit code:', r.returncode)
    print('='*60)
run('verify','input.md','output.md','--scope=format')
"

python3 -I -c "
import subprocess, json
for f in ['input.md','output.md']:
    r = subprocess.run(['python3','.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py','audit',f,'--level','2','--scope=format','--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(r.stdout)
